name: evalexpr_rhai
description: Evaluate a Rhai expression or script. Returns a JSON struct with `ok` (the result on success) or `err` (the error message). The optional second argument is a JSON `context` object accessible inside the script as `context.<field>`. Constant expressions are compiled and cached for repeat use.

examples.code: SELECT evalexpr_rhai('fn sq(x) { x * x }  sq(context.n)', { 'n': 7 }).ok;
